annotations.text:
Build Schedule — redesign

Read left → right: First run → Jump to a week → the Day builder (landing) → its states → New week → Publish.

The page grew into ~8 stacked panels before you reach a shift card. This collapses it to one working surface: a sticky action bar (week stepper + status + Publish, always visible) replaces the page-header, the whole Week panel, and the Checklist panel. One control row (role chips + Day/Week toggle) replaces the two tab rows. Landing view is the Day builder.

The landing / empty state — 'First run / setup' and 'Jump to a week'

Today's page opens on a full Week panel (a weekday select + a date field + three helper-text blocks) every visit. In the redesign that panel is gone. First run only: one calm card — pick the week-start weekday (chips), pick the first date, Start planning. After that, opening Build Schedule drops straight onto the current week; changing week is the ‹ Sep 1–7 › stepper in the action bar, which opens the 'Jump to a week' sheet (last / this / next / dated weeks, each showing its status).

What moved / merged

• Week picker: full panel → header ‹ date › stepper → 'Jump to a week' sheet
• First-run setup: 3 helper-text blocks → one 2-step card
• Checklist panel: gone → one-line ‘18/24 filled · Saved’ + status pill
• Publish: buried in a panel → persistent top-right button
• Copy last week / Start fresh: inline panel → full takeover on a new week
• ‘Copied · N conflicts’: permanent-looking panel → thin strip above the day tabs
• Manager notes: permanent panel → the ⋯ overflow menu
